name: debugpy
notes: Pinned 2026-10-30 (1.8.22, released 2026-09-15; its wheel reads Requires-Python >=3.10 and classifies 3.10 through 3.15). Universal pure-Python wheel (py2.py3-none-any — no compiled extensions; platform-independent). Metadata + hash reverified against live PyPI JSON before pinning. The adapter entry is DIRECTORY invocation: `<python> <vendor-root>/debugpy/adapter` (adapter/__main__.py self-repairs sys.path two levels up). The adapter runs on the vendored Python runtime (vendor/python.lock.json, CPython 3.14) when the build carries it, so the floor binds a machine python only when the pack is absent. Update procedure: edit version/url/sha256/sizeBytes from `curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/debugpy/<ver>/json`, run `bun run scripts/vendor/fetch-debugpy.ts`, rebuild, and re-run `bash scripts/ide/run-all.sh`.
